name: BeSure Checkout Rules
summary: Shopify app that shows, hides, renames or reorders shipping and payment methods at checkout, and blocks invalid checkouts, using rules.
best_for: Shopify store owners who want to hide, rename or reorder shipping and payment methods, or block invalid checkouts, with a few rules and a low monthly price
skip_if: you need to change which payment method is pre-selected (Shopify and the payment provider control that), you want rules in the draft order admin, or you want an app we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: The rule limits are tight on the cheaper plans: Starter allows two rules in total. A rule's condition set cannot be changed after it is created, and shipping and payment rules do not run in the draft order admin. The free plan cannot run live rules, and the Premium limit carries an asterisk the page does not explain.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per monthly, Starter $4.99 a month or $49.90 a year with 2 rules in total
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-15 on checkoutrules.com/pricing and the Shopify App Store listing, US dollars, billed through Shopify every 30 days) BeSure Checkout Rules has a Free plan that lets you test rules in testing status and works on Shopify development stores, so rules cannot go live on it. Starter costs $4.99 a month or $49.90 a year and allows only 2 rules. Advanced costs $12.99 a month or $129.90 a year and allows up to 5 shipping, 5 payment, 5 validation and 5 discount rules. Premium costs $29.99 a month or $299.90 a year and allows up to 25 rules in each of those four categories, marked with an asterisk that the page does not explain. Each paid plan has a 5-day free trial, once per Shopify store. We did not install the app, so we do not know what Shopify adds in tax.

schema_offer.description: Starter, Starter $4.99 a month or $49.90 a year with 2 rules in total; Advanced $12.99 a month or $129.90 a year with up to 5 shipping, 5 payment, 5 validation and 5 discount rules; Premium $29.99 a month or $299.90 a year with up to 25 in each category; Free plan can only test rules; each paid plan has a 5-day free trial once per Shopify store. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-15.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested BSure Checkout Rules (BeSure Checkout Rules in the dossier) on a Shopify development store: the install, one Hide shipping methods rule saved as Active, the rule list, the Billing page with three paid plans and a Free plan, a Select plan click that did nothing and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid, no approval screen was reached and the rule was not seen in a checkout. Install: the App Store listing (English) uses the address name checkout-rules, not besure-checkout-rules; it says Free plan available. Free trial available., developer StoreSpark, Built for Shopify, 189 reviews. The install form was sent at about 13:05 in our own tab; the Install app dialog asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data (customers, products, orders, discounts, Shopify Functions) and was approved. The app opened without an account, password, demo or call. In the app it is called BSure Checkout Rules. A banner says: You are on free Development plan. Test all features for free. When switching from development to a paid Shopify plan, all rules will be deactivated. Then please select a plan in this app and activate rules back. Core action, the rule Hide shipping methods: about 1.5 minutes after the install (13:05 to 13:06:30) and 9 steps: Create rule, Hide shipping methods, Select rule, a name, Add shipping method, the word Standard typed (Contains) and Save. The condition stayed Always and the status Active. The toast said Saved! Please wait 1 min then Test checkout. The list then shows Checkout rules 1 Active with the row Hide Standard shipping for all orders, Status Active, Type Shipping, Subtype Hide and Activated on November 17, 2026. No Shopify Plus and no paid plan was needed on the development store. Our first name for the rule did not fit the condition Always and was changed before saving. The onboarding card stayed at 0 of 2 tasks complete even after an active rule was saved, because it asks for the status Testing. The rule was NOT seen in a real checkout, because the store has a password and was not used for that. We also did not check whether it works within the 1 minute that the toast mentions. Plans: Settings and Billing show Starter $4.99 USD/month (Only 2 rules allowed), Advanced $12.99 USD/month, marked Most popular (Up to 5 shipping, 5 payment, 5 validation, 5 discount, and 1 cart rule allowed), Premium $29.99 USD/month (Up to 25 shipping, 25 payment, 25 validation, 25 discount, and 1 cart rule allowed *, the asterisk is not explained) and Free $0.00 USD/month (Rules can be tested using testing status, Current plan). All paid plans say FREE TRIAL FOR FIRST 5 DAYS, and a switch Monthly or Annual carries Get 2 months free. The app names one extra cart rule on each paid plan, which the App Store listing does not. Checkout: the Select plan button of Premium was greyed out, and a click on Select plan for Starter did nothing: no Shopify Approve subscription screen came up, so nothing was approved and no card was asked. The app does not say why; probably it is blocked on a development store. Cancelling: no paid plan or trial existed, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu and Uninstall; the dialog Uninstall BSure Checkout Rules? says you will no longer be able to use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason is required (a dropdown, Testing multiple apps). The app was uninstalled after the test and is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: the rule in a real checkout, a PO box rule, hiding or reordering payment methods, validation rules, discount rules, the cart rule, the paid plans, the trial, the annual prices, the asterisk at Premium and whether a rule works within 1 minute. Clean up: the app was uninstalled; no theme change was made. Other apps were not touched. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The App Store address and the name in the app differ from the dossier name, the onboarding card stays at 0 of 2 tasks even after an active rule, the Select plan click on Starter did nothing and the Premium button was greyed out without a reason, and the asterisk at Premium is not explained.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested BSure Checkout Rules (BeSure Checkout Rules in the dossier) on a Shopify development store: the install, one Hide shipping methods rule saved as Active, the rule list, the Billing page with three paid plans and a Free plan, a Select plan click that did nothing and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid, no approval screen was reached and the rule was not seen in a checkout. Install: the App Store listing (English) uses the address name checkout-rules, not besure-checkout-rules; it says Free plan available. Free trial available., developer StoreSpark, Built for Shopify, 189 reviews. The install form was sent at about 13:05 in our own tab; the Install app dialog asked for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data (customers, products, orders, discounts, Shopify Functions) and was approved. The app opened without an account, password, demo or call. In the app it is called BSure Checkout Rules. A banner says: You are on free Development plan. Test all features for free. When switching from development to a paid Shopify plan, all rules will be deactivated. Then please select a plan in this app and activate rules back. Core action, the rule Hide shipping methods: about 1.5 minutes after the install (13:05 to 13:06:30) and 9 steps: Create rule, Hide shipping methods, Select rule, a name, Add shipping method, the word Standard typed (Contains) and Save. The condition stayed Always and the status Active. The toast said Saved! Please wait 1 min then Test checkout. The list then shows Checkout rules 1 Active with the row Hide Standard shipping for all orders, Status Active, Type Shipping, Subtype Hide and Activated on November 17, 2026. No Shopify Plus and no paid plan was needed on the development store. Our first name for the rule did not fit the condition Always and was changed before saving. The onboarding card stayed at 0 of 2 tasks complete even after an active rule was saved, because it asks for the status Testing. The rule was NOT seen in a real checkout, because the store has a password and was not used for that. We also did not check whether it works within the 1 minute that the toast mentions. Plans: Settings and Billing show Starter $4.99 USD/month (Only 2 rules allowed), Advanced $12.99 USD/month, marked Most popular (Up to 5 shipping, 5 payment, 5 validation, 5 discount, and 1 cart rule allowed), Premium $29.99 USD/month (Up to 25 shipping, 25 payment, 25 validation, 25 discount, and 1 cart rule allowed *, the asterisk is not explained) and Free $0.00 USD/month (Rules can be tested using testing status, Current plan). All paid plans say FREE TRIAL FOR FIRST 5 DAYS, and a switch Monthly or Annual carries Get 2 months free. The app names one extra cart rule on each paid plan, which the App Store listing does not. Checkout: the Select plan button of Premium was greyed out, and a click on Select plan for Starter did nothing: no Shopify Approve subscription screen came up, so nothing was approved and no card was asked. The app does not say why; probably it is blocked on a development store. Cancelling: no paid plan or trial existed, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the menu and Uninstall; the dialog Uninstall BSure Checkout Rules? says you will no longer be able to use the app, that any data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason is required (a dropdown, Testing multiple apps). The app was uninstalled after the test and is gone from the installed apps. Not tested: the rule in a real checkout, a PO box rule, hiding or reordering payment methods, validation rules, discount rules, the cart rule, the paid plans, the trial, the annual prices, the asterisk at Premium and whether a rule works within 1 minute. Clean up: the app was uninstalled; no theme change was made. Other apps were not touched. Our own tabs were closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The App Store address and the name in the app differ from the dossier name, the onboarding card stays at 0 of 2 tasks even after an active rule, the Select plan click on Starter did nothing and the Premium button was greyed out without a reason, and the asterisk at Premium is not explained.
